name: fhir-validate
description: Validate FHIR resources for conformance and PHI safety.
body: Validate the FHIR resources in $ARGUMENTS using the `healthcare-fhir` skill. Check resource conformance/profiles and terminology, and flag any PHI that would leak into logs/analytics. Report issues and fixes. Defensive/compliance-aware.

name: pci-scope
description: Assess a payment flow's PCI scope and card-data handling.
body: Assess the payment flow in $ARGUMENTS using the `fintech-payments`/`security-compliance` skills. Identify where card/PII data flows and whether it (wrongly) touches your systems, check idempotency on charges, and flag float money math. Recommend how to minimize PCI scope. Read-only.

name: inventory-audit
description: Audit inventory/checkout for oversell and tampering risks.
body: Audit the commerce flow in $ARGUMENTS using the `ecommerce-platform` skill. Look for inventory race conditions (oversell), client-trusted prices/carts, and non-idempotent order placement. Report risks with fixes. Read-only.

name: sketch
body: Scaffold a creative-coding sketch for $ARGUMENTS using the `creative-coding`/`generative-art` skills. Set up the chosen framework with a seeded RNG (reproducible), a clean animation loop, and export. Keep the draw loop allocation-free. Report how to run it.

name: tinyml
description: Optimize/quantize a model for microcontroller/edge deployment.
body: Optimize the model in $ARGUMENTS for edge using the `tinyml-edge-ai` skill. Quantize and measure the RAM/flash footprint and latency against the target device, and report the accuracy tradeoff. Flag if it won't fit the budget.

name: finops
description: Produce a FinOps cost report with rightsizing/savings.
body: Produce a FinOps report for $ARGUMENTS using the `finops-cloud`/`cloud-cost-optimization` skills. Break down spend by allocation/tags, compute unit economics, and identify idle/oversized resources and egress waste. Rank savings by impact. Read-only.

name: carbon
description: Estimate and reduce a system's carbon/energy footprint.
body: Estimate the carbon/energy footprint for $ARGUMENTS using the `greenops-sustainability` skill. Identify inefficiency (waste = carbon), region/grid choices, and carbon-aware scheduling opportunities. Report measured/estimated impact and concrete reductions — no greenwashing.

name: render
body: Render the motion-graphics project in $ARGUMENTS using the `motion-graphics-code`/`video-processing` skills (Remotion/Lottie/etc.). Ensure deterministic renders, optimize render time, and report the output and any performance issues.
